name: @alpsckr/unity_cli
description: Windows-first CLI for Unity CLI automation.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate:extensions && npm run generate:registries && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/gen-command-contract.mjs && node scripts/gen-protocol.mjs && node scripts/gen-tool-schemas.mjs && npm run generate:registries && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:test: npm run clean && npm run generate:extensions && npm run generate:registries && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/gen-command-contract.mjs && node scripts/gen-protocol.mjs && node scripts/gen-tool-schemas.mjs && npm run generate:registries && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/copy-test-resources.cjs
scripts.architecture:validate: node scripts/audit-final-architecture.mjs --strict && node scripts/audit-security-consistency.mjs --strict && node scripts/audit-tool-completion-contract.mjs --strict && node scripts/audit-static-capability-catalog.mjs
